about: matrix-hardline's layers, checked by tests/test_bridge_layering.py on every test run with the shared checker (components/capabilities/_testing/layers.py). Two files: the adapter, the one module that imports hardline and matrix both, and the package surface over it. 'why' keys are read by neither checker.
scan_why: Every Python file in the package. Tests are out of scan: a test builds hardline runtimes on its mock backend by design.

why.hardline, matrix: the two packages it bridges, each through its public surface (tests/test_bridge_layering.py holds it to each __all__)
why.pydantic: its config and the failed call's record are pydantic models, as matrix's typed configs are
why.forbid: hardline traces its own calls, an agent framework is matrix's to run over the port, and the adapter reads no environment and no file: hardline finds its own tiers

why.matrix_hardline.runtime: re-exports the adapter's names; importlib.metadata reads the installed version

single_importer_why: the adapter is the one module that speaks hardline, so a change of hardline's reply or runtime is one file
